posts.headline: The draft's been over for days and Thicks still hasn't given this league a reason to believe the #FreeMaxx dynasty is anything but one shiny ring propping up a 14-14 career record.
posts.detail: Two seasons, a 5.5 average finish, and the receipts still don't match the swagger — the reigning champs need to actually show up before the pressure talk becomes a punchline.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner has now said NOTHING through five straight editions, and Put it in Ra's absurd 20-8 record with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings remains the most disrespected résumé in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: Back-to-back top-two finishes and still no hardware — at some point the silence stops looking humble and starts looking like a man who knows he's about to choke again.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafted a full roster and did absolutely nothing to erase the title of worst résumé in the league.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish don't get fixed by a war room — the untalented tenth needs actual football evidence before anyone believes this offseason changed anything.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World enters the season still needing to explain how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Megamind's got the ring and the reputation, but a 5.5 average finish says the brains behind that big head haven't translated to consistent winning yet.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way opens the season still stuck with the scars of a rookie 6-8, 10th-place finish, and Auntie Thomas hasn't shown this league a single reason to expect different.
posts.detail: A bottom-feeder tier with nothing but debut disappointment on the résumé — the hard way looks like the only way until Pharaoh23 proves otherwise on the field.
